mapper.select: SELECT boardlike.id , boardlike.deleted , boardlike.created_at as createdAt , boardlike.modified_at as modifiedAt , boardlike.user_id as userId , boardlike.board_id as boardId , boardlike.liked FROM boardlike WHERE boardlike.id = #{id}
SELECT boardlike.id , boardlike.board_id as boardId , boardlike.user_id as userId , boardlike.liked FROM boardlike
SELECT count(boardlike.id) as listsize FROM boardlike

SELECT boardlike.id FROM boardlike
ORDER BY boardlike.id DESC ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{perpage}

SELECT boardlike.id FROM boardlike
AND #{cursor} > boardlike.id ORDER BY boardlike.id DESC
AND boardlike.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY boardlike.id ASC
LIMIT 0, #{perpage}
